subject: Supplier portal invite redirects to generic login — tenant bind failing
messages:
From: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@auroracorp.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-06T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Trouble accepting Redwood supplier invite (Aurora Corp)

Hi David,

We received the supplier portal invite this morning but when our buyer clicks the "Accept" link it takes them to a generic Redwood sign-in page (looks like the public /login) instead of the Coupa onboarding flow. They don't have Redwood accounts, so there is nowhere to enter the vendor profile. Screenshot attached.

Quick details:
- Company: Aurora Corp
- Invite sent to: procurement@auroracorp.com
- Link in invite: https://portal.redwood.ai/accept?v=eyJ... (truncated)

Can you check whether the invite is tied to the wrong tenant or if some relaystate is missing? We tried in Chrome and Edge, same result. This is blocking the PO process — buyer says they have a live PO pending.

Thanks,
Hannah Liu
Senior Procurement Manager
Aurora Corp

Attachment: invite-screenshot.png (image/png)
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@auroracorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Redwood supplier invite (Aurora Corp)

Hi Hannah — thanks for the report and screenshot. I'm sorry for the friction.

Couple quick checks:
1) Can you confirm if the original invite was generated from Coupa or from our Zip onboarding route?
2) Can you forward the raw invite email HTML? sometimes forwarding strips the accept params.

Looping in Marissa from Onboarding (CC) so we can check the invite payload and tenant binding. We'll triage and get back within 2 hours. In the meantime, if you can paste the full invite link that would help.

Best,
David
Technical Account Manager, Redwood Inference

--- Forwarded message ---
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>

(see above)

--- End forwarded message ---

Triage notes:
- Invite was generated via Coupa integration path but our payload shows relayState param empty and tenant_id set to "default" (should be aurora-corp-tenant).
- Likely cause: our invite generator fell back to the public link when vendor email matched an existing alias mapping (we recently changed alias normalization).
- Impact: buyer lands on /login where there is no accept flow and no SAML relay for Coupa.

Ben — can you confirm whether the invite can be reissued with the explicit tenant_id and a signed relayState? If not, can we generate a short-term manual accept link and I will re-send to Aurora? PO is time-sensitive.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Dedicated
Attachment: vendor-profile.csv (text/csv)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@auroracorp.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Redwood supplier invite (Aurora Corp)

Hi team — looked into the logs. Confirmed that the invite generator omitted relayState when the recipient's domain matched a legacy alias rule (edge case in alias normalization). This caused the frontend to treat the request as an unauthenticated public login and not forward to the Coupa accept flow.

Immediate remediation steps I can run now (choose one):
A) Reissue invite with explicit tenant_id=aurora-corp-tenant and signed relayState (recommended). Link will expire in 7 days.
B) Create a one-time accept URL scoped to procurement@auroracorp.com (valid for 48 hours) and I will send it directly.

I've prepared an audit-friendly reissue and a manual accept URL. Marissa/David, tell me which to use and I'll re-send. Logged fix for alias normalization; full rollback/patch will be in patch-2026.09.08.

Technical note (for records):
- Error observed: missing_relaystate_v2 (internal id 0x3a7f)
- Affected subsystem: invite-generator-service v1.8.2

Ben Carter
SRE, Redwood Inference (serving/runtime & portal)
From: Hannah Liu <hannah.liu@auroracorp.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Trouble accepting Redwood supplier invite (Aurora Corp)

Thanks, Ben — option B (one-time accept URL) would be faster for us. Buyer needs to claim the invite this afternoon (they're trying to push the PO through).

Please send the manual URL to procurement@auroracorp.com and I'll confirm once accepted. If you can also paste the PPE audit link or ticket id, I can attach to our PO notes.

Appreciate the fast turn.
Hannah
